sources.title: Three-component interface compatibility does not prove image use
sources.details: Let v1=(1,2,3), v2=(3,2,1) and row weight w=(0,0,0). Both vectors have D=3 and w@vi is defined, but w@v1=0+0+0=0=w@v2.
